arStrings.szText: "Is that really you, Lycander? Why have you come here?"
Rectifying a mistake I should have settled years ago.
I was so close! The magic is gone again.
I see that you will not be dissuaded. I foresee your doom, but doom is your birthright. Leaving you both to flounder on your own is more dangerous than helping you.
The Eye is tainted with Hatred. A sickness festers at its core, and it must be cut out—purged with my blood.
But know this: such a cleansing is no repair. The Eye will hold but for one vision.
I will aid you on this foolish quest. My workshop still exists somewhere beneath the ruin and reshaping of Sanctuary. I do not know what name the place bears now—too much has changed.
All I can remember is that it was where Lovers Say Farewell. Find it, and I will meet you there.
